articles.title: The Universe Is Speeding Up—And Scientists Just Dodged a Big Mistake!
articles.summary: Imagine blowing up a balloon and it inflates faster every second. That's our universe! New research says dark energy is still pushing it apart faster, fixing a scary error from last year.

articles.title: Moon Art Is Lying to You! Why Scientists Want More Realistic Lunar Paintings
articles.summary: Those cool pictures of astronauts on a smooth, clean moon? Totally fake! A space expert says artists need to show the real moon—dusty, bumpy, and full of craters—so we're ready for future missions.

articles.title: This Tiny Drone Is a Beginner's Dream—And It's $30 Off Right Now!
articles.summary: The DJI Neo drone weighs less than a smartphone, flies itself, and shoots 4K video. It's on sale for $169 before Amazon Prime Day—perfect for kids and beginners who want to capture the sky.
